DsbeXbpLGrXTQrUZGreyOQ.zh: 今年第20週(5/18-24)全球陽性率由低點略升至1.24%,其中,東南亞區、西太平洋、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加,整體疫情已連續2週上升。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1(占47.22%) 為主,其次為BA.3.2及JN.1(各占18.33%)。 中國疫情於低點略升,第23週(6/1-7)門急診陽性率略升為3.6%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 新加坡疫情從高點波動下降,第22週陽性率降至11%,疫情已連續兩週下降,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。
DsbeXbpLGrXTQrUZGreyOQ.en: In week 20 of this year (18–24 May), the global COVID-19 positivity rate rose slightly from a low point to 1.24%, with positivity increasing markedly in the South-East Asia, Western Pacific and Eastern Mediterranean Regions, and overall activity has risen for 2 consecutive weeks. The predominant circulating variants globally are NB.1.8.1 (47.22%), followed by BA.3.2 and JN.1 (18.33% each). In China, outpatient and emergency department positivity rose slightly to 3.6% in week 23 (1–7 June), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for the majority of variants. Singapore's outbreak has fluctuated downward from a peak, with positivity falling to 11% in week 22. Cases have declined for 2 consecutive weeks, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for the majority of variants.

p-VAjvfsWK8RS8p45kNzag.zh: 今年第17週(4/27-5/3)全球陽性率下降為0.86%,其中,東南亞、東地中海區署陽性率明顯增加。近期全球流行變異株以NB.1.8.1為主(占34.86%)、其次為XFG(占22.48%)及JN.1(占21.1%)。 中國疫情於低點略增,第20週(5/11-17)門急診陽性率略增為1.7%,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。 新加坡疫情持續上升,第19週新增1萬2,700例病例,較第18週(8,000例)增加,近期住院率亦上升,另第17週陽性率為16.78%,當局表示疫情上升原因與群體免疫下降有關,變異株以NB.1.8.1占大宗。
p-VAjvfsWK8RS8p45kNzag.en: In week 17 (27 April–3 May), the global positivity rate fell to 0.86%, with a marked increase in positivity in the WHO regional offices for South-East Asia and the Eastern Mediterranean. Circulating variants are mainly NB.1.8.1 (34.86%), followed by XFG (22.48%) and JN.1 (21.1%). In China, positivity at outpatient and emergency visits rose slightly from a low point to 1.7% in week 20 (11–17 May), with NB.1.8.1 accounting for most variants. In Singapore, the outbreak continues to rise: 12,700 cases were reported in week 19, up from 8,000 in week 18, and hospitalisation rates have also risen recently. Positivity in week 17 was 16.78%. Authorities say the rise is linked to declining population immunity, and NB.1.8.1 accounts for most variants.

qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.zh: 每月更新:  全球自2022年截至今年3/31累計144國/地區報告18萬2,945例確診病例,其中,至少503例死亡。 今年3月共計48國家/地區報告1,235 例新增確診病例,其中5例死亡(CFR 0.4%),70.4%的病例來自非洲地區,相較今年2月,東地中海及西太平洋區病例數上升,其餘地區疫情下降,哥倫比亞、丹麥、厄瓜多和新加坡通報首例 Ib 型病例。 非洲地區近6週(2026/3/9-4/19)共計16國通報969例確診病例,其中3例死亡(CFR 0.3%),以馬達加斯加、剛果民主共和國、幾內亞、肯亞、蒲隆地為高;非洲以外地區,阿根廷、丹麥、德國、巴基斯坦、葡萄牙、新加坡、西班牙及英國已持續出現Ib型社區傳播。 巴基斯坦信德省通報一起院內群聚事件(前已掌握),傳播原因主要為共用保溫箱、氧氣設備及設備表面受污染。在3至4月期間,該省9縣(/30縣)共29例確診與8例死亡(CFR 28%),死亡個案均為6個月以下嬰兒,基因定序確認為Ib型變異株。
qKUxc6-Q6_UeTClgmVK8Jw.en: Monthly update: globally, since 2022 and as of 31 March this year, 144 countries and territories have reported 182,945 confirmed cases cumulatively, of which at least 503 died. In March this year, 48 countries and territories reported 1,235 new confirmed cases, including five deaths (CFR 0.4%). 70.4% of cases came from the African region. Compared with February, cases rose in the Eastern Mediterranean and Western Pacific regions and fell in other regions. Colombia, Denmark, Ecuador and Singapore reported their first clade Ib cases. In the African region, over the past six weeks (9 March–19 April), 16 countries reported 969 confirmed cases, including three deaths (CFR 0.3%), with the highest numbers in Madagascar, the DRC, Guinea, Kenya and Burundi. Outside Africa, Argentina, Denmark, Germany, Pakistan, Portugal, Singapore, Spain and the United Kingdom have continued to show clade Ib community transmission. Sindh Province in Pakistan reported a hospital cluster (already known), with transmission mainly attributed to shared incubators and oxygen equipment and contaminated equipment surfaces. In March and April, the province's nine of 30 districts recorded 29 confirmed cases and eight deaths (CFR 28%). All deaths were in infants under six months, and genetic sequencing confirmed a clade Ib variant.

GEJP9U5iGbz6zaIjmItLMQ.zh: 新加坡首次報告首起Ib型(clade Ib)本土傳播病例,第1例為30歲男性,近期無旅遊史,3/25出現症狀,3/31確診;第2例為34歲男性,近期有旅遊史,與第1例個案有長時間身體接觸,3/26出現症狀,4/1確診。該國今年截至3/21累計報告7例病例,去年累計報告23例病例。
GEJP9U5iGbz6zaIjmItLMQ.en: Singapore has reported its first locally transmitted clade Ib mpox cases. Case 1 is a 30-year-old man with no recent travel history, who developed symptoms on 25 March and was confirmed on 31 March. Case 2 is a 34-year-old man with recent travel history who had prolonged physical contact with case 1; he developed symptoms on 26 March and was confirmed on 1 April. As of 21 March this year, Singapore has reported 7 cumulative cases, and 23 cases were reported last year.

SOoS2dnJxSxyd6t4TFqOxw.zh: 疫情更新:  今年第9週(2/23-3/1)全球陽性率降為2.35%,其中僅西太平洋及非洲區署陽性率明顯增加。 新加坡疫情上升,第9週陽性率為4.23%,變異株以JN.1為主。 美國疫情呈下降趨勢,第10週陽性率降至3.4%,變異株以XFG為主。  評估與建議:  近期全球流行變異株以XFG占比最高(占48.79%),其次為NB.1.8.1(23.39%)。WHO公布之COVID-19全球長期快速風險評估(第9版),評估COVID-19對全球公共衛生的整體風險屬中等。鑑於自然感染與疫苗帶來的群體免疫力提升,以及臨床治療的進步,全球住院與死亡數自2022年以來明顯下降。 目前多數流行變異株為Omicron JN.1及其衍生亞型,雖具備免疫逃脫能力,但不至於造成疾病嚴重度增加,惟有6%的有症狀病例出現長新冠症狀;現階段COVID-19尚未形成穩定季節性流行規律,多數國家已減少常規檢測通報,汙水與定醫監測成為重要的補充監測方式。 WHO指出,目前COVID-19疫苗疫苗仍能有效預防重症與死亡,並建議優先保護高風險族群、與流感疫苗共同施打;同時透過《冠狀病毒疾病威脅管理策略計劃》呼籲各國整合防治計畫,持續加強監測、保護高風險族群、維持醫療與公衛韌性,並落實風險溝通。
SOoS2dnJxSxyd6t4TFqOxw.en: Epidemic update: In week 9 of this year (23 February–1 March), the global positivity rate fell to 2.35%, with a notable increase only in the WHO Western Pacific and African Regions. Singapore's epidemic is rising, with a positivity rate of 4.23% in week 9 and JN.1 the predominant variant. The United States' epidemic is declining, with the positivity rate down to 3.4% in week 10 and XFG the predominant variant. Assessment and recommendations: XFG currently has the highest share of circulating variants globally (48.79%), followed by NB.1.8.1 (23.39%). WHO's global long-term rapid risk assessment for COVID-19 (9th edition) rates the overall risk to global public health as moderate. Given population immunity from natural infection and vaccination, and advances in clinical treatment, global hospitalizations and deaths have declined markedly since 2022. Most circulating variants are Omicron JN.1 and its descendant subtypes; although they have immune escape capacity, they do not cause greater disease severity, but 6% of symptomatic cases develop long COVID symptoms. COVID-19 has not yet established a stable seasonal pattern, and most countries have reduced routine testing and reporting, so wastewater and sentinel physician surveillance have become important supplementary methods. WHO notes that current COVID-19 vaccines remain effective at preventing severe disease and death, and recommends prioritizing high-risk groups and co-administration with influenza vaccines. Through its Strategic Plan for Coronavirus Disease Threat Management, WHO calls on countries to integrate prevention and control plans, continue strengthening surveillance, protect high-risk groups, maintain health system and public health resilience, and implement risk communication.

J9mOD7KAe-Od8DFzhTkiLA.zh: 新加坡今年1月報告11例確定病例,皆未具完整疫苗接種史,其中3例為12個月以下嬰兒,另除1例為遊客外,其餘皆為該國居民,其中7例近期具海外旅遊史。當局表示今年病例數高於去(2025)年同期(2例)。另11例病例中,有3例經實驗室檢測具基因關聯性,惟病例間無相同暴露史,可能存在未被發現之社區傳播,流行病學仍在調查中。
J9mOD7KAe-Od8DFzhTkiLA.en: Singapore reported 11 confirmed cases in January this year, none of whom had a complete vaccination history. Three were infants under 12 months old. Apart from one visitor, all were residents of Singapore, and 7 had recent overseas travel history. Authorities say case numbers this year are higher than the 2 cases in the same period last year. Among the 11 cases, 3 showed genetic links by laboratory testing, but there was no common exposure history among cases, so undetected community transmission may exist, and epidemiological investigation is ongoing.

iNWe5elwnuQeRAYk3gHxfQ.zh: 美國於1/29報告65例病例,其中14例住院,病患分布於28個州,發病日介於2025年8/22至今年1/11,與典型的季節性(夏末至初秋達到高峰)模式不同。經當局調查疑感染源為某生產商製造之辣木葉粉,商品已下架。 新加坡今年第3週(1/18-24)報告22例病例,較近5年同期中位數(24例)低;近期發表的研究顯示該國2019年之沙門氏菌感染症病例累計2,050例,占該國食物相關傳染病之大宗(占33%),並造成812萬美元之經濟負擔。CDA 1/29、Value in Health Regional Issues 1/16
iNWe5elwnuQeRAYk3gHxfQ.en: The United States reported 65 cases on 29 January, 14 of them hospitalised, across 28 states, with onset dates between 22 August 2025 and 11 January 2026. This differs from the typical seasonal pattern, which peaks from late summer to early autumn. Authorities suspect the source is moringa leaf powder produced by one manufacturer, and the product has been removed from sale. Singapore reported 22 cases in week 3 (18–24 January), below the five-year median of 24 for the same period. A recently published study found 2,050 cumulative Salmonella infection cases in Singapore in 2019, the largest share of food-related infectious diseases (33%), with an economic burden of US$8.12 million. Sources: CDA, 29 January; Value in Health Regional Issues, 16 January.

smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.zh: 新加坡疫情呈上升趨勢,今年第2週(1/11-17)平均每日新增18例,為2025年10月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情趨緩,第3週病例數較前4週平均下降19.8%;韓國第3週(1/11-17)就診率為千分之1.5,較前1週下降,惟仍高於去年同期。
smOxUtQm9eXHd8xUzodEIQ.en: Singapore's situation is rising. In week 2 (11–17 January) this year, an average of 18 new cases were reported per day, the highest since October 2025, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation has eased; in week 3, case numbers fell 19.8% compared with the average of the previous four weeks. In South Korea, the outpatient visit rate in week 3 (11–17 January) was 1.5 per 1,000, down from the previous week but still higher than the same period last year.

Nu5wlm-aQZay9DbVAGpZrQ.zh: 新加坡疫情持續,第1週(1/4-10)平均每日新增15例,與前兩週相當,疫情為去年11月以來最高,惟仍低於去年同期或去年最高點;越南疫情持續,2025年累計報告約10萬例病例,較2024年增加28.9%,雖然近期之疫情下降,惟仍持續通報重症個案,疫情多集中於胡志明市、河內等,當局已發布警報;韓國疫情從低點略增,第2週就診率為千分之2,較前1週上升,且高於去年同期。
Nu5wlm-aQZay9DbVAGpZrQ.en: Singapore's situation continues. In week 1 (4–10 January), an average of 15 new cases were reported per day, similar to the previous two weeks and the highest since November last year, though still below the same period last year and last year's peak. Viet Nam's situation continues: about 100,000 cases were reported cumulatively in 2025, an increase of 28.9% over 2024. Although recent cases have declined, severe cases are still being reported, with outbreaks concentrated in Ho Chi Minh City, Hanoi and elsewhere, and authorities have issued alerts. South Korea's situation has risen slightly from a low point; the outpatient visit rate in week 2 was 2 per 1,000, higher than the previous week and higher than the same period last year.

9HlBBmSedvRKmUs0yHCYdQ.zh: 新加坡疫情上升,2025年第52-53週平均每日新增15例,為11月以來最高,惟仍低於2024年同期;另鄰近國家/地區如中國、香港、日本、韓國及泰國疫情處低點或呈下降趨勢。
9HlBBmSedvRKmUs0yHCYdQ.en: Singapore's situation is rising. In weeks 52–53 of 2025, an average of 15 new cases were reported per day, the highest since November, though still below the same period in 2024. Neighbouring countries and regions, including China, Hong Kong, Japan, South Korea and Thailand, are at low levels or declining.

LMb6h92n1YqFwb7c3j55PA.zh: 中國疫情快速上升,10月報告逾37萬例病例,較9月(15萬例)倍增;日本疫情處低點,第45週(11/3-9)定醫平均報告數0.14,已連續8週下降,且低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,第45週平均每日報告11例,與近2週相當,且低於去年同期。
LMb6h92n1YqFwb7c3j55PA.en: China's outbreak is rising rapidly: more than 370,000 cases were reported in October, doubling from September (150,000 cases). Japan's outbreak is at a low point: in week 45 (3–9 November), the average number of reports per sentinel medical facility was 0.14, having declined for eight consecutive weeks and below the same period of the past three years. Singapore's outbreak is also at a low point: in week 45, an average of 11 cases per day were reported, similar to the past two weeks and lower than the same period last year.

R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第31週(7/28-8/3)全球陽性率6.06%,創今年新高,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署陽性率皆增加。 中國疫情於低點小幅度反彈,第33週(8/11-17)定醫門急診陽性率上升至11.9%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高;香港疫情小幅反彈,第33週陽性率上升至1.5%,以變異株NB.1.8.1占比最高(54%),另XFG占0.3%。 西太平洋區署第31週疫情更新,日本陽性率上升至43%,韓國陽性率上升至23%,其他國家如新加坡、印、寮國、澳洲及紐西蘭等陽性率皆下降。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲、歐洲、東南亞區署呈上升趨勢;全球流行變異株由XFG占比最高,其次為NB.1.8.1及LP.8.1。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
R3OmGmQ_EGdjsAohMelCTA.en: Epidemiological update: in week 31 of 2025 (28 July–3 August), global test positivity was 6.06%, the highest this year, with increases in the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions. China's outbreak has rebounded slightly from a low: sentinel outpatient and emergency positivity rose to 11.9% in week 33 (11–17 August), with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant. Hong Kong's outbreak rebounded slightly: positivity rose to 1.5% in week 33, with NB.1.8.1 the predominant variant (54%) and XFG at 0.3%. In the Western Pacific Region's week 31 update, positivity rose to 43% in Japan and 23% in South Korea, while positivity fell in other countries including Singapore, India, Lao PDR, Australia and New Zealand. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, with the Americas, Europe and South-East Asia regions rising. The predominant global variant is XFG, followed by NB.1.8.1 and LP.8.1. WHO notes that most countries have integrated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infection surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early warning and surveillance systems, continue tracking variant trends, report outbreak information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

bUCX9RjRekF0DzITYjCXaQ.zh: 亞洲國家第28-30週(7/6-26)疫情更新,日本疫情持平,定醫平均病例數0.59,低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,平均每日新增20例病例,與前兩週相同;泰國今年截至7月累計報告3.4萬例,死亡0例,最常見的病患年齡組依序為0-4歲、5-9歲、10-14歲。
bUCX9RjRekF0DzITYjCXaQ.en: Update for Asian countries for weeks 28–30 (6–26 July): Japan's outbreak is flat, with a sentinel average of 0.59, lower than the same period over the past three years. Singapore's outbreak is at a low level, with an average of 20 new cases per day, the same as in the previous two weeks. Thailand reported 34,000 cases cumulatively this year as of July, with no deaths; the most common age groups among patients are 0–4, 5–9 and 10–14 years, in that order.

tuq9MA_04s_cWZY69-WZqw.zh: 亞洲國家第26-28週(6/22-7/12)疫情更新,香港疫情上升,就診陽性率為0.8‰,為今年最高;日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.52,惟低於近3年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,每日平均病例數為25例。
tuq9MA_04s_cWZY69-WZqw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 26–28 (22 June–12 July): Hong Kong's epidemic is rising, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.8‰, the highest this year. Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.52 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Singapore's epidemic is at a low point, with an average of 25 cases per day.

QuiYIaurLcL39Znv-lI_0g.zh: 亞洲國家第25-27週(6/15-7/5)疫情更新,日本疫情呈上升趨勢,定醫平均病例數0.42,惟低於近3年同期;香港疫情波動,就診陽性率為0.5‰,低於近2年同期;新加坡疫情處低點,每日平均病例數為20例,為今年最低。
QuiYIaurLcL39Znv-lI_0g.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 25–27 (15 June–5 July): Japan's epidemic is on an upward trend, with an average of 0.42 cases per sentinel clinic, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is fluctuating, with a clinic positivity rate of 0.5‰, lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic is at a low point, with an average of 20 cases per day, the lowest this year.

LOsxU752gRR6B43jaHX2Sw.zh: 亞洲國家第23-25週(6/1-21)疫情更新,日本疫情上升,定醫平均病例數0.25,為今年最高,惟低於近3年同期;韓國疫情上升,就診陽性率2.6‰,為今年最高,惟低於近2年同期;新加坡疫情已明顯下降,平均單日新增29例病例,仍高於近5年同期;香港疫情持平,就診陽性率為0.2‰。
LOsxU752gRR6B43jaHX2Sw.en: Updates for Asian countries for weeks 23–25 (1–21 June): Japan's epidemic is rising, with an average of 0.25 cases per sentinel clinic, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 3 years. South Korea's epidemic is rising, with clinic positivity of 2.6‰, the highest this year, though lower than the same period over the past 2 years. Singapore's epidemic has clearly declined, with an average of 29 new cases per day, still higher than the same period over the past 5 years. Hong Kong's epidemic is stable, with clinic positivity of 0.2‰.

ysIhmFiNr2TvoVqhHwHL1Q.zh: 新加坡6/18報告2例本土病例,今年迄今累計7例病例,今年病例數與去年同期相當,當局已加強相關監測措施。 韓國今年迄今累計2例病例,均為境外移入,該國自2016年以來累計報告41例病例,其中40例為境外移入。
ysIhmFiNr2TvoVqhHwHL1Q.en: Singapore reported 2 local cases on 18 June, and has recorded 7 cases so far this year, similar to the same period last year. Authorities have strengthened related surveillance measures. South Korea has recorded 2 cases so far this year, both imported. Since 2016, South Korea has reported 41 cases cumulatively, 40 of them imported.

o873ur_A3pgZQT2TBbr2zQ.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第19週(5/5-11)全球陽性率約3%,以東地中海、西太平洋、東南亞區之陽性率增加較為顯著。 WHO報告全球疫情自今年2月起顯著上升,近期陽性率已接近去年7月高峰;變異株LP.8.1佔比自4月中旬開始下降,NB.1.8.1佔比上升,於5月中旬達10.7%;WHO評估目前全球風險仍高,惟公衛風險迄未受到監測中之變異株影響。 第17-20週(4/20-5/17)疫情,新加坡陽性率自13%上升至20%;澳大利亞陽性率自2.4%上升至3%,變異株XEC及LP.8.1佔比最高;馬來西亞第15-18週陽性率持續上升,自8%上升至24%,每日通報至少110例病例;香港第21週陽性率11.1%,低於前一週(13.8%),疫情仍處高點,惟呈開始下降趨勢,定醫就診率亦下降,汙水監測及呼吸道樣本顯示,變異株NB.1.8.1佔比最高。  評估與建議:  全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,東地中海、西太平洋、歐洲、東南亞區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株仍以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
o873ur_A3pgZQT2TBbr2zQ.en: Epidemic update: in week 19 of 2025 (5–11 May), the global positivity rate was about 3%, with more significant increases in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and South-East Asia regions. WHO reports that the global outbreak has risen significantly since February this year, and recent positivity rates are approaching last July's peak. The share of the LP.8.1 variant has declined since mid-April, while the share of NB.1.8.1 has risen to 10.7% in mid-May. WHO assesses that the current global risk remains high, although public health risk has not so far been affected by the variants under monitoring. In weeks 17–20 (20 April–17 May), positivity in Singapore rose from 13% to 20%; in Australia it rose from 2.4% to 3%, with XEC and LP.8.1 the most prevalent variants; in Malaysia, positivity in weeks 15–18 continued to rise, from 8% to 24%, with at least 110 cases reported daily. Hong Kong's positivity in week 21 was 11.1%, lower than the previous week (13.8%). The outbreak remains at a high level but has begun to decline, and sentinel clinic consultation rates have also fallen; wastewater and respiratory sample surveillance show NB.1.8.1 as the most prevalent variant. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward, including in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific, European and South-East Asian regions, and the LP.8.1 variant still accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

5h8XK1d3tpcXZwcTXPOJvw.zh: 疫情更新:  2025年第17週(4/21-27)全球陽性率約2.7%,陽性率以東地中海區、西太平洋區及非洲區為高。 中國陽性率自4月初7.5%持續上升至4月底16.2%,其中,南部省份陽性率高於北部省份,目前門急診類流感呼吸道病原體陽性率以新冠病毒為最高;香港第19週(5/4-10)陽性率持續上升,已超過最近52週高點,定醫就診率亦呈上升趨勢,污水監測數據顯示,變異株XDV占比最高。 新加坡第18週(4/27-5/3)新增約14,200例病例,高於前1週11,100例病例,目前主要流行變異株為LF.7及NB.1.8。  評估與建議: 全球陽性率近期呈上升趨勢,其中,美洲區持平,其他地區皆呈上升趨勢;目前全球流行變異株以LP.8.1占比最高。WHO表示多數國家已將COVID-19納入常規呼吸道傳染病監測,建議各國提供民眾可負擔及可信賴的檢測、治療及疫苗,維持預警監視系統及持續追蹤變異株趨勢,並向WHO通報疫情資訊及維持COVID-19期間所建立之基礎設施。
5h8XK1d3tpcXZwcTXPOJvw.en: Epidemic update: in week 17 of 2025 (21–27 April), the global positivity rate was about 2.7%, highest in the Eastern Mediterranean, Western Pacific and African regions. China's positivity rose steadily from 7.5% in early April to 16.2% at the end of April; positivity was higher in southern provinces than in northern provinces, and among influenza-like respiratory pathogens detected in outpatient and emergency settings, COVID-19 had the highest positivity. In Hong Kong, positivity in week 19 (4–10 May) continued to rise and has exceeded the high of the past 52 weeks; sentinel clinic consultation rates are also rising, and wastewater surveillance data show the XDV variant accounts for the largest share. In Singapore, about 14,200 cases were added in week 18 (27 April–3 May), up from 11,100 cases the previous week; the main circulating variants are currently LF.7 and NB.1.8. Assessment and recommendations: global positivity has recently been trending upward; the Americas are flat, while other regions are all rising. The LP.8.1 variant currently accounts for the largest share globally. WHO notes that most countries have incorporated COVID-19 into routine respiratory infectious disease surveillance, and recommends that countries provide affordable and trustworthy testing, treatment and vaccines, maintain early-warning surveillance systems and continue tracking variant trends, report epidemic information to WHO, and maintain the infrastructure established during the COVID-19 period.

E7um2KjfV-o4eb9TBaq7xQ.en: On 7 February Singapore reported one imported vaccine-associated case: a 5-month-old Indian girl with immunodeficiency. She had received a polio vaccine in India and developed fever and acute limb weakness and paralysis in December 2024. She was admitted to isolation on arrival in Singapore, and her condition is stable. Authorities are following 3 close contacts, including family members and caregivers. Singapore has reported no local case since 1978; its most recent imported case was reported in 2006, and the risk of community transmission is assessed as low.

qT8Mj2O9JYUl31LZ_Zo2dA.zh: 韓國近期監測顯示HMPV住院數上升,其中以0-6歲占48.6%為多,其次為65歲以上族群(20.4%)及7-12歲兒童(18.2%),檢出率從第49週3.2%上升至52週之5.3%,當局表示目前仍低於閾。 新加坡HMPV病例數上升,於2024年12月,社區之ARI樣本中之HMPV病例占比由0.8%上升至9%,惟趨勢與往年一致,研判為年底社交聚會和假期旅行增加所致;馬來西亞2024年報告327例HMPV病例,較2023年增加45%。
qT8Mj2O9JYUl31LZ_Zo2dA.en: South Korea's recent surveillance shows rising hMPV hospitalisations, with the largest share among children aged 0–6 (48.6%), followed by people aged 65 and over (20.4%) and children aged 7–12 (18.2%). The detection rate rose from 3.2% in week 49 to 5.3% in week 52, and authorities state that it remains below the threshold. Singapore: hMPV cases have risen. In December 2024, the share of hMPV among acute respiratory infection (ARI) samples from the community rose from 0.8% to 9%. However, the trend is consistent with previous years, and authorities attribute it to increased social gatherings and holiday travel at the end of the year. Malaysia reported 327 hMPV cases in 2024, an increase of 45% over 2023.

tiFaYcwGwtFURPneaJnYBg.en: Singapore's cases rose this year: as of mid-December 2024, 108 cases had been reported cumulatively, 5.7 times the full-year total for 2023. Authorities urge children and pregnant women to be vaccinated. New Zealand's cases have surged: about 160 cases were added in a single week recently, and 1,490 cases had been reported cumulatively as of mid-December 2024, compared with only 141 cases in the whole of 2023. One third of patients were aged 5–14 years, and the hospitalisation rate was 8.7%.
